# squawk-cli for the migration lint in ci.yml's architecture job, installed with
# pip install --require-hashes. It has no dependencies. Regenerate when the pin moves:
#   printf 'squawk-cli==<version>\n' > squawk.in
#   uv pip compile squawk.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --no-header -o .github/requirements/squawk.txt
# and move the version in scripts/lint_migrations.sh and docs/MIGRATIONS.md with it.
